translation: That I could still support everything was perhaps not without the strength of my disorderly rubbing. Later, because of the soreness and pain of the waist and legs, someone transmitted to me the method of sunning: in the dog days, naked in the blazing sun, sunning myself, sweat flowed like water, and when the wind came it was cool and refreshing, and I did not feel the heat. Only at the first sunning did the skin necessarily peel, the thickness following the disease, and even water blisters arose; the healing was extremely fast, never more than two days; truly the work of transformation.
